ImpressoContentItem.description: This schema defines the JSON representation of a paper-based content item — either printed or typewritten. A content item corresponds to any logical segmentation unit of a digitised media production, at or below the page level for printed documents. In newspapers, for example, an article is a typical type of content item.

ImpressoContentItem.yaml:
ImpressoContentItem:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: "This schema defines the JSON representation of a paper-based content item \u2014\
      \ either printed or typewritten. A content item corresponds to any logical segmentation unit\
      \ of a digitised media production, at or below the page level for printed documents. In newspapers,\
      \ for example, an article is a typical type of content item."
    annotations:
      impresso: content
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        description: The unique identifier for a content item (CI), (e.g. GDL-1900-01-02-a-i0001,
          or SOC_CJ-1940-07-22-a-i0001)
        annotations:
          impresso: content.id
        pattern: ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-[a-z]{1,2}-i[0-9]{4}$
      ts:
        required: true
        description: timestamp of creation of the JSON file (in '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ' format e.g.
          '2018-09-18T08:00:08Z')
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ts
        pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z$
      publication_date:
        alias: d
        description: Date of publication of issue or broadcast to which the content item belongs
          to in yyyy-mm-dd format.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.d
        pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$
      cc:
        description: True if image box coordinates are known to be correct (eg. have been checked,
          converted or rescaled), False otherwise
        annotations:
          impresso: content.cc
        range: boolean
      olr:
        required: true
        description: True if optical layout recognition was applied to the issue/bulletin this content
          item originates from.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.olr
        range: boolean
      st:
        description: The type of media source to which this content item belongs. Must be a value
          from the impresso-essentials.utils SourceType enum.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.st
        equals_string_in:
        - newspaper
        - radio_broadcast
        - radio_magazine
        - radio_schedule
        - monograph
        - encyclopedia
      sm:
        description: The medium in which the source media this content item belongs to was originally
          produced. For printed documents, this relates to the physical paper support.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.sm
        equals_string_in:
        - print
        - typescript
      tp:
        required: true
        description: content item type (e.g. 'ar' for article, 'ad' for advertisement)
        annotations:
          impresso: content.tp
          nullable: true
      lg:
        description: Language of the content item's text, expressed as a two-letter ISO 639-1 language
          code.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.lg
        pattern: ^[a-z]{2,3}$
      rc:
        description: Radio channel, if applicable (st=='radio_broadcast') and is known.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.rc
          nullable: true
      rp:
        description: Radio program, if applicable (st=='radio_broadcast') and is known.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.rp
          nullable: true
      media_title_variant:
        description: Variant title of the media title this CI is from (mainly in the case of BL newspapers).
          The field is present only when a meaningful variant title is available.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.media_title_variant
          json_min_length: 1
      title_text:
        alias: t
        description: Content-item title (deprecated).
        annotations:
          impresso: content.t
          nullable: true
      title:
        description: Content-item title.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.title
          nullable: true
      ro:
        description: Reading order index of the content item, for the table of contents view on the
          interface. If not defined, the CI number (after 'i' in the ID) should be used.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ro
        range: integer
      consolidated:
        description: True if the issue this CI comes from was consolidated, meaning it contains additional
          language identification and ocrqa information.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.consolidated
        range: boolean
      consolidated_reocr_applied:
        description: True if the CI's text went through the re-OCRisation process.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.consolidated_reocr_applied
        range: boolean
      consolidated_ocrqa:
        description: Estimated OCR quality, between 0 and 1. May be null if there is no text or not
          enough text to compute an estimate.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.consolidated_ocrqa
          nullable: true
        range: double
        minimum_value: 0
        maximum_value: 1
      lg_original:
        description: Language of the content item in the original OCR/OLR. Only defined if the content-item
          was consolidated.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.lg_original
          nullable: true
      is_exact_date:
        description: False if the date assigned to the issue is known to be inexact or approximated,
          True or undefined otherwise.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.is_exact_date
        range: boolean
      section_title:
        description: A section title grouping this content item with others.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.section_title
        range: ImpressoContentSection
        inlined: true
      pp:
        description: Array of physical page numbers spanned by the content item, based on the issue
          pagination as extracted from the OCR.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.pp
        multivalued: true
        minimum_cardinality: 1
        range: double
      ft:
        description: The rebuilt full text.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ft
      rb:
        description: text offsets of page regions (relative to 'ft' field)
        annotations:
          impresso: content.rb
        multivalued: true
        range: integer
      pb:
        description: text offsets of physical paragraph breaks (relative to 'ft' field)
        annotations:
          impresso: content.pb
        multivalued: true
        range: integer
      lb:
        description: text offsets of physical line breaks (relative to 'ft' field)
        annotations:
          impresso: content.lb
        multivalued: true
        range: integer
      ppreb:
        description: List of rebuilt pages
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb
        multivalued: true
        range: ImpressoRebuiltPage
        inlined_as_list: true
    rules:
    - preconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          sm:
            required: true
      postconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          st:
            required: true
    - preconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          st:
            required: true
      postconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          sm:
            required: true
    - preconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          consolidated:
            required: true
      postconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          consolidated_ocrqa:
            required: true
          lg_original:
            required: true
    - preconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          st:
            required: false
            equals_string: radio_broadcast
      postconditions:
        slot_conditions:
          ro:
            required: false
            equals_number: 1
    tree_root: true

    extra_slots:
      allowed: true

    annotations:
      impresso: content.section_title
    attributes:
      title_text:
        required: true
        description: A section title grouping this content item with others.title_text.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.section_title.title_text
      composing_ci_ids:
        required: true
        description: A section title grouping this content item with others.composing_ci_ids.

          impresso: content.section_title.composing_ci_ids
        multivalued: true
      section_id:
        required: true
        description: A section title grouping this content item with others.section_id.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.section_title.section_id

ImpressoRebuiltPage.description: The rebuilt tokens and region boxes for one physical page of this content item.

fields.description: Page canonical ID
fields.name: id

shape.description: Page canonical ID

fields.description: page number
fields.name: n

shape.description: page number

fields.description: List of region coordinates.
fields.name: r

fields.description: List of tokens
fields.name: t

shape.description: List of tokens

ImpressoRebuiltPage.yaml:
ImpressoRebuiltPage:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: The rebuilt tokens and region boxes for one physical page of this content item.
    annotations:
      impresso: content.ppreb[]
    attributes:
      id:
        description: Page canonical ID
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].id
        pattern: ^[A-Za-z_]+-\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-[a-z]{1,2}-p[0-9]{4}$
      page_number:
        alias: n
        description: page number
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].n
        range: integer
      tokens:
        alias: t
        description: List of tokens
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].t
        multivalued: true
        range: ImpressoRebuiltToken
        inlined_as_list: true
      regions:
        alias: r
        description: List of region coordinates.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].r
        range: integer
        array:
          dimensions:
          - minimum_cardinality: 0
          - minimum_cardinality: 4
            maximum_cardinality: 4

ImpressoRebuiltToken.description: The rebuilt tokens and region boxes for one physical page of this content item.t[].

fields.description: Coordinates of token relative to page.
fields.name: c

shape.description: Coordinates of token relative to page.

fields.description: token length
fields.name: l

shape.description: token length

fields.description: offset start (relative to ft field)
fields.name: s

shape.description: offset start (relative to ft field)

ImpressoRebuiltToken.yaml:
ImpressoRebuiltToken:
    extra_slots:
      allowed: true
    description: The rebuilt tokens and region boxes for one physical page of this content item.t[].
    annotations:
      impresso: content.ppreb[].t[]
    attributes:
      coordinates:
        alias: c
        description: Coordinates of token relative to page.
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].t[].c
        multivalued: true
        minimum_cardinality: 4
        maximum_cardinality: 4
        range: integer
      start:
        alias: s
        description: offset start (relative to ft field)
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].t[].s
        range: integer
      length:
        alias: l
        description: token length
        annotations:
          impresso: content.ppreb[].t[].l
        range: integer
